query:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'INSPECTED') AND (r."DEFECTIVE" > 0)) THEN (0 + r."DEFECTIVE") ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "VALUE"
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."SUPPLIER") = RTRIM(:p_supplier)))
hana:
PROCEDURE "enterprise::QUALITY_DEFECTS" (
  IN rows TABLE ("COMPANY" NVARCHAR(4), "SUPPLIER" NVARCHAR(20), "STATUS" NVARCHAR(12), "DEFECTIVE" BIGINT),
  IN p_company NVARCHAR(255),
  IN p_supplier NVARCHAR(255),
  OUT result BIGINT
)
LANGUAGE SQLSCRIPT
SQL SECURITY INVOKER
READS SQL DATA
AS
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ((RTRIM(r."STATUS") = 'INSPECTED') AND (r."DEFECTIVE" > 0)) THEN (0 + r."DEFECTIVE") ELSE 0 END), 0) INTO result
FROM :rows AS r
WHERE ((RTRIM(r."COMPANY") = RTRIM(:p_company)) AND (RTRIM(r."SUPPLIER") = RTRIM(:p_supplier)));
END;

semantics.characterComparison: RTRIM preserves ABAP fixed-character trailing-space comparison
semantics.numericBoundary: Source inputs and every intermediate arithmetic value must fit signed ABAP 32-bit integers; target BIGINT extends capacity only after separate qualification
